title: Bacoor mayor orders probe of pet crematorium over dumped remains

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Bacoor City Mayor Strike Revilla has ordered a probe into the operations of Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium, following the discovery of 29 dead pets allegedly dumped in San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan, on Oct. 30. “We will not stop until the full truth is established and anyone found responsible is held accountable,” Revilla wrote in a Facebook post in Filipino on Saturday night. The mayor directed the City Legal Office, Business Permit and Licensing Department (BPLD), City Environment Service Department, and City Veterinary Office to investigate the establishment.
